brief:
Israeli occupation forces closed the entrance to al-Maghir village, northeast of Ramallah, on Sunday evening, according to Shehab Wire. The closure prevented residents from entering or leaving the community and blocked access to the neighboring village of Abu Fellah. Soldiers stationed at the checkpoint detained several citizens during the operation.

The blockade cut off movement between the two villages in the area north of the Palestinian city of Ramallah, disrupting normal civilian passage and trapping residents on both sides of the closure.
